info.title: Fred API
info.description:
Generated from packages/api. Run `npm run gen:api` at the repo root after changing it.

Every route serves example data for now (response header `X-Fred-Data: example`). Sign in at /login first; "Try it out" uses your session.

DataSearchUpdated.description: Chat part data-search-updated: the Dealbreakers chips

DataScan.description: Chat part data-scan: "Checked 186 new listings · 9 steps"

DataSuggestions.description: Chat part data-suggestions: quick replies. Tapping one sends its label as a message.

DataWatch.description: Chat part data-watch: "Watching for new places…". Also sent as an event.

reason.example: Asked for a deposit before a viewing

startsAt.description: Null until a time is confirmed

AlertMode.description: instant_strong = message me about strong fits right away; daily = one digest; off = only in the app

source.description: read_from_text = pulled from the description, less certain

message.description: The newest AI SDK UIMessage only; the server keeps the history

200.description: You, your search in one line, sidebar counts
Newest first. Group by foundAt in the user's time zone.

201.description: Draft tour. Fred drafts the message; nothing is sent until you say so.

200.description: AI SDK UI message stream. Custom parts: data-search-updated, data-scan, data-suggestions, data-watch
Server-sent events; each data line is one Event
